scores.rationale: Tax amounts in LSB and BVP with "056.28" and FF123456789 look fake. Taxes exceed USD total 325.00, FRA-BER 08:15 to 14:30 says 135 minutes, a 2020-born infant, three unrelated surnames on one booking.

Natural BA274 LHR-JFK, GBP total with GB and US taxes, ticket number and reference look real. Arrival 13:15Z with 470 minutes only works as local time labelled Z, a minor offset slip. bookingId echoed.

TP flight plus SNCF TGV connection is a nice touch, but ids a1d2e3f4-5b6c, last4 4242 and +351912345678 feel patterned. bookingId echoed, connection times and durations line up, ticketed with tickets.

Portuguese family with TAP Miles&Go numbers, holder "NUNO M FERREIRA", sequential e-tickets, mailbox.org email and real OPO-LIS-MAD routing read as production data. Durations match times, EUR throughout, id echoed.
Credible TAP itinerary to Ponta Delgada with EUR taxes; ticket 0471234567890 is a bit patterned. TP1863 12:15 to 15:40 is 205 minutes but says 145, TP1864 11:10 to 12:55 is 105 but says 165.

Navarro family, varied FF programs, BA117 and AA flights with correct offsets feel real. First leg 10:15Z to 17:05-05:00 is 710 minutes but durationMinutes says 410. JFK connection and return otherwise fit; id echoed.
Stock values: Alice Smith, reference BK1234, ticket 1234567890123, BA123, last4 4242, round 850.00 and 120.00. Times and duration match, id echoed, but status confirmed while a ticketNumber exists.

Rich IB itinerary with real airports, but fictional "Harbor Miles" and "Northstar Rewards" stand out. All three durations ignore the offsets: 08:00+00:00 to 12:15+01:00 is 195 minutes, not 255; same on later legs.
